name: Wuji Glove
summary: Wuji Glove is a human-hand data-capture glove for robotic teleoperation, tactile research and human-robot interaction. A 24 × 31 pressure matrix contains 526 active sensing points and outputs tactile data at 120 FPS. Five fingertip electromagnetic receivers track position and orientation at 120 Hz, while a six-axis IMU samples at 800 Hz. The manufacturer specifies 67.5 g net glove mass and 192.6 g including cables. USB-C supplies 5 V / 1 A, and an adapter provides RJ45 100BASE-TX networking. EMF tracking is sensitive to metal and ferromagnetic materials. Python/C SDK and CLI tools support data

description.en: Wuji Glove is a human-hand data-capture glove for robotic teleoperation, tactile research and human-robot interaction. A 24 × 31 pressure matrix contains 526 active sensing points and outputs tactile data at 120 FPS. Five fingertip electromagnetic receivers track position and orientation at 120 Hz, while a six-axis IMU samples at 800 Hz. The manufacturer specifies 67.5 g net glove mass and 192.6 g including cables. USB-C supplies 5 V / 1 A, and an adapter provides RJ45 100BASE-TX networking. EMF tracking is sensitive to metal and ferromagnetic materials. Python/C SDK and CLI tools support data subscription, recording and calibration; commercial shipping status is not established by the contact-to-purchase page.
